targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "value" FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='success') * 100.0 / NULLIF(count(*),0))::int AS "value" FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type IN ('scenario.completed','scenario.failed') AND $__timeFilter(received_at);
SELECT count(DISTINCT payload->'scenario'->>'user_email') AS "value" FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND payload->'scenario'->>'user_email' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT avg((payload->'scenario'->>'offers_count')::int)::int AS "value" FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'offers_count' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT $__timeGroup(received_at, '1h') AS time, type AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type LIKE 'scenario.%' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT (payload->'scenario'->>'origin') || ' → ' || (payload->'scenario'->>'destination') AS route, count(*) AS searches FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'destination' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15;

SELECT received_at AS "Время", payload->'scenario'->>'user_email' AS "Email", data AS "Запрос", (payload->'scenario'->>'offers_count')::int AS "Офферов", status AS "Статус", payload->'scenario'->>'aviasales_url' AS "URL Aviasales" FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT received_at AS "Время", payload->'scenario'->>'user_email' AS "Email", data AS "Запрос", payload->'scenario'->>'error_type' AS "Тип ошибки", payload->'scenario'->>'error_message' AS "Сообщение" FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='scenario.failed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 50;
